taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-20, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 64.6 | 2.65 | 2.65
2 | 775.4 | 0.67 | 3.32
3 | 110.3 | 1.09 | 4.41
4 | 222.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-20, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Report: Station T-20**

Station T-20 exhibits a 4-layer geoelectric section:
- **Layer 1:** 64.6 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 2.65 m (topsoil/weathered zone)
- **Layer 2:** 775.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.67 m (resistive hard layer/compact rock)
- **Layer 3:** 110.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.09 m (fractured/saturated horizon)
- **Layer 4:** 222.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, basement layer extending from 4.41 m depth

Analyzing consecutive layer resistivities:
- Layers 1–3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ ($64.6 < 775.4 > 110.3$), defining a **K**-type curve.
- Layers 2–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ ($775.4 > 110.3 < 222.5$), defining an **H**-type curve.

The resulting sound curve is **KH-type**, which fully matches the interpretation on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "KH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
